title: Print Footer Navbar Parity
description: The print LaTeX footer leaves too much space below it and should sit closer to the physical page bottom.
summary: Fixed print footer sitting too high above the page bottom. KOMA was overriding fancy page styles so chapter/TOC pages only showed a bare page number; chrome footer never rendered. Applied chrome styles after preamble end for fancy/plain/scrplain/scrheadings, reduced bottom margin to a single spacing unit, and anchored the chrome footer at the physical page bottom via eso-pic shipout (skipping empty/title pages). Verified on paper.pdf page 2.
